questions.question: Please review the durable proposed success definition/plan weekly-definition.json v2 (SHA256 5c008799a593f1dbf8ae84da54312528854131806df027a02aed8375dec484bb) before implementation. It retains your exact MANIFEST/OUTPUT schemas, host and actual-byte hash checks, separate per-employer latest-record/cohort-count calculations, sorted aggregate-only packet, sanitized rejection and all-or-nothing atomic output with old bytes preserved; adds operator instructions, bounded CLI/failure/privacy/isolation checks and unchanged earlier artifacts. Recommend a new standard-library wrapper over unchanged intake_report.py; manual copying risks wrong policy/stale/partial output, while a portal/scheduler is unnecessary/out of scope. Proposed weekly interpretation: full snapshots, no invented time filter/TTL; trusted operator binds inputs to employers and refreshes engineering evidence, keeps combined packet internal and shares only the recipient's aggregate report. Output aliases to protected resources are rejected; after failure preserved old output is NOT a new successful handoff. Engineer update 57e5b820/current peer result ca4c9ad5 verified Cedar r4 (3 participants/4 sessions/all consent) and Birch r8 (2/2/consent optional); I independently hash-matched both, so expected ready=1 for EACH employer, not a mixed cohort. Important unresolved limit: original cancelled peer mutation settlement receipt is inaccessible and NOT certified. I propose read-only consumption of these verified current bytes only—no replay, mutation, lock release or claim to settle the old work. Approve this definition/plan for bounded local execution with that explicit limit, or require authorized original-settlement evidence before any consumption? Review approval will not be reported as implementation correctness, production readiness, or learning/consent/commercial evidence.

criteria: Proposal follows actual code/input inspection and distinguishes observed facts from business choices.
An informed human exchange resolves the operational workflow, privacy/distribution and failure behavior.
Separate employer identity and current policy provenance are explicit; reused labels/IDs cannot mix.
Viable approaches are compared with a reasoned choice appropriate to the bounded local handoff.
Consequential dependencies and failure modes have concrete mitigation or explicit unresolved decisions.
The success definition covers the supplied interface/output, actual evidence and preservation requirements.
The plan connects investigation, implementation, verification and deliverable evidence without claiming approval proves success.
QA scope and production/customer limits remain explicit; no needless new system is presumed necessary.
rubric.policy: Coordinator is the disclosed scripted QA participant. Review actual artifacts/questions/source events. Choose only frozen response text; record all decisions. Artifact format is flexible. No prescribed number of questions or conversation length. At most one rejection/revision round; preserve failures, don't repair code or coach implementation.

policy: Record explicit review decision against exact available artifacts/question; no assumed proposal filename or automatic approval.
